_comment: test/** holds intentional raw-button fixtures; eval/checks.exs IS the banned-pattern detector (its regex literals would self-match); lib/lantern_ui/lint.ex defines the patterns it detects and lib/lantern_ui/llms.ex documents them for models. Component internals (components/**) render real <button>/<table> DOM by definition — the hand_* rules target app code bypassing the library, so they are scoped off there while every other rule still runs.
